plugins.name: Chrome 隔离出口启动器
plugins.summary: 每个身份一份完全隔离的 Chrome profile，各自绑定出口：本机 VPN、http(s)/socks5 代理，或 Clash 订阅节点。
plugins.summaryEn: One isolated Chrome profile per identity, each pinned to its own egress: local VPN, http(s)/socks5 proxies, or Clash subscription nodes.

plugins.name: 微信桌面提醒
plugins.summary: 在这台 Mac 上操作微信桌面版，把任务出错、在等你回答等提醒发给你核对过的接收人；发前三重核对，每步留截图。
plugins.summaryEn: Sends MultiCC alerts (failures, questions waiting for you) to recipients you verified, by driving WeChat for Mac; three checks before every send, with screenshots at each step.

releases.notes: 首个公开版本：接收人绑定（定位核对 → 测试发送 → 手机确认）、投递队列与九步核对的真实发送；需要带插件 API 2 的 MultiCC。
releases.notesEn: First public release: recipient binding (locate and title check, test send, phone confirmation), delivery queue, and real sending with nine checks. Needs a MultiCC with plugin API 2.
